translations.idiomatic: When the coffin next reached south of Luo, Prince of Xianyang Xi and others knew the true death and looked at each other, "Without the last edict, we brothers would also have made a plan to remove her.

sentences.zh: 豈可令失行婦人宰製天下，殺我輩也？

translations.literal: How could we let a woman of lost conduct rule the realm and kill us?"
translations.idiomatic: How could we let a woman of lost conduct rule the realm and kill us?"

sentences.zh: 」諡曰幽皇后，葬長陵塋內。

translations.literal: Posthumous title You Empress; buried within Changling mound.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous title You Empress; buried within Changling mound.

sentences.zh: 其後有司奏請加號，諡曰文昭貴人。

translations.literal: Later the authorities memorialized to add title; posthumous title Wenzhao noble lady.
translations.idiomatic: Later the authorities memorialized to add title; posthumous title Wenzhao noble lady.

sentences.zh: 孝文從之。

translations.literal: Xuanwu followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu followed it.

sentences.zh: 宣武踐阼，追尊配饗。

translations.literal: When Xuanwu took the throne, he posthumously honored paired sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanwu took the throne, he posthumously honored paired sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 后先葬在長陵東南，陵制卑局，因就起山陵，號終寧陵。

translations.literal: The empress was first buried southeast of Changling; the tomb system was low and cramped; therefore a mountain tomb was raised nearby, called Zhongning Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was first buried southeast of Changling; the tomb system was low and cramped; therefore a mountain tomb was raised nearby, called Zhongning Tomb.

sentences.zh: 置邑戶五百家。

translations.literal: Five hundred settlement households were set.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred settlement households were set.

sentences.zh: 明帝時，更上尊號太后，以同漢、晉之典，正姑婦之禮，廟號如舊文昭。

translations.literal: Under Mingdi, the superior title Empress Dowager was further raised, like Han and Jin institutions, rectifying aunt and daughter-in-law ritual; temple title as before Wenzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Under Mingdi, the superior title empress dowager was further raised, like Han and Jin institutions, rectifying aunt and daughter-in-law ritual; temple title as before Wenzhao.

sentences.zh: 遷靈櫬於長陵兆內西北六十步。

translations.literal: The spirit coffin was moved within Changling's precinct northwest sixty paces.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit coffin was moved within Changling's precinct northwest sixty paces.

sentences.zh: 初，開終寧陵數丈，于梓宮上獲大蛇，長丈餘，黑色，頭有王字，蟄而不動；

translations.literal: At first, opening Zhongning Tomb several zhang, on the inner coffin a great serpent more than a zhang, black, head bearing the character wang, coiled without moving;
translations.idiomatic: At first, opening Zhongning Tomb several zhang, on the inner coffin a great serpent more than a zhang, black, head bearing the character wang, coiled without moving;

sentences.zh: 靈櫬既遷，還置蛇舊處。

translations.literal: when the spirit coffin was moved, the serpent was returned to its old place.
translations.idiomatic: when the spirit coffin was moved, the serpent was returned to its old place.

sentences.zh: 宣武順皇后于氏，太尉烈弟勁之女也。

translations.literal: Xuanwu Shun Empress Yu was daughter of Lie's younger brother Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu Shun Empress Yu was daughter of Lie's younger brother Jin.

sentences.zh: 宣武始親政事，烈時為領軍，總心膂之任。

translations.literal: When Xuanwu first personally handled government, Lie was then commander-in-chief, holding the heart-and-liver charge.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanwu first personally handled government, Lie was then commander-in-chief, holding the heart-and-liver charge.

sentences.zh: 以嬪御未備，左右諷諭，稱后有容德，帝乃迎入為貴人。

translations.literal: Because pin and attendants were not complete, attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and virtue—the emperor then welcomed her as noble lady.
translations.idiomatic: Because pin and attendants were not complete, attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and virtue—the emperor then welcomed her as noble lady.

sentences.zh: 時年十四，甚見寵愛，立為皇后。

translations.literal: Age fourteen; she was greatly favored and established empress.
translations.idiomatic: Age fourteen; she was greatly favored and established empress.

sentences.zh: 后靜默寬容，性不妒忌。

translations.literal: The empress was silent, tolerant, and by nature not jealous.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was silent, tolerant, and by nature not jealous.

sentences.zh: 生皇子，三歲夭沒。

translations.literal: She bore a prince; at three years he died young.
translations.idiomatic: She bore a prince; at three years he died young.

sentences.zh: 其後暴崩，宮禁事秘，莫能知悉，而世議歸咎于高夫人。

translations.literal: Afterward she died suddenly; palace affairs were secret—none could know fully; worldly opinion blamed Lady Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward she died suddenly; palace affairs were secret—none could know fully; worldly opinion blamed Lady Gao.

sentences.zh: 葬永泰陵，諡曰順皇后。

translations.literal: Buried at Yongtai Tomb; posthumous title Shun Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Buried at Yongtai Tomb; posthumous title Shun Empress.

sentences.zh: 宣武皇后高氏，文昭皇后弟偃之女也。

translations.literal: Xuanwu Empress Gao was daughter of Wenzhao Empress's younger brother Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu Empress Gao was daughter of Wenzhao Empress's younger brother Yan.

sentences.zh: 宣武納為貴嬪，生皇子，早夭；

translations.literal: Xuanwu took her as noble consort; she bore a prince who died young;
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu took her as noble consort; she bore a prince who died young;

sentences.zh: 又生建德公主。

translations.literal: also bore Princess of Jiande.
translations.idiomatic: also bore Princess of Jiande.

sentences.zh: 後拜為皇后，甚見禮重。

translations.literal: Later she was made empress; greatly honored in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Later she was made empress; greatly honored in ritual.

sentences.zh: 性妒忌，宮人希得進御。

translations.literal: Jealous by nature; palace women rarely won access.
translations.idiomatic: Jealous by nature; palace women rarely won access.

sentences.zh: 及明帝即位，上尊號曰皇太后。

translations.literal: When Mingdi took the throne, she was honored Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingdi took the throne, she was honored empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 尋為尼，居瑤光寺。

translations.literal: Soon she became a nun at Yaoguang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Soon she became a nun at Yaoguang Temple.

sentences.zh: 非大節慶不入宮中。

translations.literal: Except great festivals she did not enter the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Except great festivals she did not enter the palace.

sentences.zh: 建德公主始五六歲，靈太后出覲母武邑君，時天文有變，靈太后欲以當禍，是夜暴崩，天下冤之。

translations.literal: Princess of Jiande was only five or six; Empress Dowager Ling went out to visit her mother Lady of Wuyi; at the time astronomy had a change; the empress dowager wished to use it as calamity—that night she died suddenly; the realm resented it.
translations.idiomatic: Princess of Jiande was only five or six; Empress Dowager Ling went out to visit her mother Lady of Wuyi; at the time astronomy had a change; the empress dowager wished to use it as calamity—that night she died suddenly; the realm resented it.

sentences.zh: 喪還瑤光佛寺，殯皆以尼禮。

translations.literal: The coffin returned to Yaoguang Buddhist Temple; burial all used nun ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The coffin returned to Yaoguang Buddhist Temple; burial all used nun ritual.

sentences.zh: 初，孝文幽后之寵也，欲專其愛，後宮接御，多見阻遏。

translations.literal: At first when Xiaowen You Empress was favored, he wished to monopolize her love; rear-palace access was much blocked.
translations.idiomatic: At first when Xiaowen You Empress was favored, he wished to monopolize her love; rear-palace access was much blocked.

sentences.zh: 孝文時言於近臣，稱婦人妒防，雖王者亦不能免，況士庶乎。

translations.literal: Xiaowen spoke to close ministers, saying women's jealousy and guard—even kings cannot avoid it, how much more gentlemen and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaowen spoke to close ministers, saying women's jealousy and guard—even kings cannot avoid it, how much more gentlemen and commoners.

sentences.zh: 宣武高后悍忌，嬪御有至帝崩不蒙侍接者。

translations.literal: Xuanwu's Empress Gao was fierce and jealous; pin and attendants often to the emperor's death did not receive attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu's Empress Gao was fierce and jealous; pin and attendants often to the emperor's death did not receive attendance.

sentences.zh: 由是在洛二十餘年，皇子全育者唯明帝而已。

translations.literal: Therefore at Luo for more than twenty years, among princes fully reared there was only Mingdi.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore at Luo for more than twenty years, among princes fully reared there was only Mingdi.

sentences.zh: 宣武靈皇后胡氏，安定臨涇人，司徒國珍女也。

translations.literal: Xuanwu Ling Empress Hu was a man of Linjing in Anding, daughter of Minister of State Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu Ling Empress Hu was a man of Linjing in Anding, daughter of Minister of State Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 母皇甫氏，產后之日，赤光四照。

translations.literal: Mother Lady Huangfu; on the day the empress was born, red light shone on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Mother Lady Huangfu; on the day the empress was born, red light shone on four sides.

sentences.zh: 京兆山北縣有趙胡者，善於卜相，國珍問之，胡云：「賢女有大貴之表，方為天地母，生天地主，勿過三人知也。

translations.literal: In Shanyang county north of the capital was Zhao Hu, skilled at divination; Guozhen asked him; Hu said: "The worthy daughter has great honor's signs—she will be Heaven and Earth's mother, bear Heaven and Earth's lord—do not let more than three know."
translations.idiomatic: In Shanyang county north of the capital was Zhao Hu, skilled at divination; Guozhen asked him; Hu said, "The worthy daughter has great honor's signs—she will be Heaven and Earth's mother, bear Heaven and Earth's lord—do not let more than three know."

sentences.zh: 」后姑為尼，頗能講道。

translations.literal: The empress's aunt was a nun and could expound the Way.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's aunt was a nun and could expound the Way.

sentences.zh: 宣武初，入講禁中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuanwu she entered to lecture in the forbidden inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuanwu she entered to lecture in the forbidden inner palace.

sentences.zh: 積歲，諷左右稱后有姿行。

translations.literal: After years attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: After years attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and conduct.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，乃召入掖庭，為充華世婦。

translations.literal: The emperor heard and summoned her into the rear apartments as chonghua world wife.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard and summoned her into the rear apartments as chonghua world wife.

sentences.zh: 而椒庭之中，以國舊制，相與祈祝，皆願生諸王、公主，不願生太子。

translations.literal: In the pepper chambers by state old system they prayed together, all wishing to bear kings and princesses, not wishing to bear the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the pepper chambers by state old system they prayed together, all wishing to bear kings and princesses, not wishing to bear the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 唯后每稱：「夫人等言，何緣畏一身之死而令皇家不育塚嫡也？

translations.literal: Only the empress each time said: "Ladies say—why fear one body's death and make the royal house bear no tomb heir?"
translations.idiomatic: Only the empress each time said, "Ladies say—why fear one body's death and make the royal house bear no tomb heir?"

sentences.zh: 」明帝在孕，同列猶以故事相恐，勸為諸計。

translations.literal: When Mingdi was in the womb, her peers still by precedent frightened her and urged various schemes.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingdi was in the womb, her peers still by precedent frightened her and urged various schemes.

sentences.zh: 后固意確然，幽夜獨誓，但使所懷是男，次第當長子，子生，身死不辭。

translations.literal: The empress's intent was firm; in dark night she alone vowed—only let what she bore be male; in order he should be eldest son; when the son was born, she would not refuse death.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's intent was firm; in dark night she alone vowed—only let what she bore be male; in order he should be eldest son; when the son was born, she would not refuse death.

sentences.zh: 既誕明帝，進為充華嬪。

translations.literal: When Mingdi was born, she was advanced to chonghua pin.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingdi was born, she was advanced to chonghua pin.

sentences.zh: 先是，宣武頻喪皇子，自以年長，深加慎護，為擇乳保，皆取良家宜子者，養于別宮，皇后及充華皆莫得而撫視焉。

translations.literal: Earlier Xuanwu repeatedly lost princes; himself thinking he was advanced in years, he deeply added careful guard; wet-nurses were chosen from good families with fit sons, reared in a separate palace—empress and chonghua all could not nurture and view.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xuanwu repeatedly lost princes; himself thinking he was advanced in years, he deeply added careful guard; wet-nurses were chosen from good families with fit sons, reared in a separate palace—empress and chonghua all could not nurture and view.

sentences.zh: 及明帝踐阼，尊后為皇太妃，后尊為皇太后。

translations.literal: When Mingdi took the throne, the empress was honored Grand Imperial Consort; the empress dowager was honored empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingdi took the throne, the empress was honored grand imperial consort; the empress dowager was honored empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 臨朝聽政，猶曰殿下，下令行事。

translations.literal: She held court and heard government, still saying Hall Below; orders were issued as commands.
translations.idiomatic: She held court and heard government, still saying Hall Below; orders were issued as commands.

sentences.zh: 后改令稱詔，群臣上書曰陛下，自稱曰朕。

translations.literal: The empress dowager changed orders to edicts; ministers' memorials said Your Majesty; she called herself zhen.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager changed orders to edicts; ministers' memorials said Your Majesty; she called herself zhen.

sentences.zh: 太后以明帝沖幼，未堪親祭，欲傍《周禮》夫人與君交獻之義，代行祭禮。

translations.literal: The empress dowager, because Mingdi was young and could not personally sacrifice, wished beside Zhou Rites' lady and lord mutual presenting meaning to substitute in performing sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager, because Mingdi was young and could not personally sacrifice, wished beside Zhou Rites' lady and lord mutual presenting meaning to substitute in performing sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 禮官博議以為不可，而太后欲以幃幔自鄣，觀三公行事。

translations.literal: Ritual officers broadly debated it as impossible; yet the empress dowager wished to screen herself with curtains and observe the three dukes' conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers broadly debated it as impossible; yet the empress dowager wished to screen herself with curtains and observe the three dukes' conduct.

sentences.zh: 重問侍中崔光，光便據漢和熹鄧后薦祭故事。

translations.literal: She again asked Attendant-in-Chief Cui Guang; Guang then cited Han Emperor He and Empress Dowager Deng's presenting sacrifice precedent.
translations.idiomatic: She again asked Attendant-in-Chief Cui Guang; Guang then cited Han Emperor He and Empress Dowager Deng's presenting sacrifice precedent.

sentences.zh: 太后大悅，遂攝行初祀。

translations.literal: The empress dowager greatly rejoiced and then held the first sacrifice in proxy.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager greatly rejoiced and then held the first sacrifice in proxy.

sentences.zh: 太后性聰悟，多才藝，姑既為尼，幼相依託，略得佛經大義。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was intelligent and comprehending, with many talents and arts; her aunt had been a nun; from youth depending on her, she roughly grasped Buddhist scriptures' great meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was intelligent and comprehending, with many talents and arts; her aunt had been a nun; from youth depending on her, she roughly grasped Buddhist scriptures' great meaning.

sentences.zh: 親覽萬機，手筆斷決。

translations.literal: She personally viewed the myriad tasks and decided with her own hand.
translations.idiomatic: She personally viewed the myriad tasks and decided with her own hand.

sentences.zh: 幸西林園法流堂，命侍臣射，不能者罰之。

translations.literal: Visiting Xilin Garden's Faliu Hall, she ordered attendants to shoot; those who could not were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Visiting Xilin Garden's Faliu Hall, she ordered attendants to shoot; those who could not were punished.

sentences.zh: 又自射針孔，中之，大悅，賜左右布帛有差。

translations.literal: Also she herself shot at a needle's hole—hit it; greatly pleased, she bestowed left and right cloth and silk in grades.
translations.idiomatic: Also she herself shot at a needle's hole—hit it; greatly pleased, she bestowed left and right cloth and silk in grades.

sentences.zh: 先是，太后敕造申訟車，時御焉。

translations.literal: Earlier the empress dowager ordered built the appeal carriage; at the time she rode it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the empress dowager ordered built the appeal carriage; at the time she rode it.

sentences.zh: 出自雲龍大司馬門，從宮西北，入自千秋門，以納冤訟。

translations.literal: Out from Yunlong Grand Marshal Gate, from the palace's northwest, entering by Qianqiu Gate, to receive wrongful suits.
translations.idiomatic: Out from Yunlong Grand Marshal Gate, from the palace's northwest, entering by Qianqiu Gate, to receive wrongful suits.

sentences.zh: 又親策孝、秀、州郡計吏於朝堂。

translations.literal: Also she personally examined filial and excellent prefectural and commandery clerks in the court hall.
translations.idiomatic: Also she personally examined filial and excellent prefectural and commandery clerks in the court hall.

sentences.zh: 太后與明帝幸華林園，宴群臣於都亭曲水，令王公以下賦七言詩。

translations.literal: The empress dowager with Mingdi visited Hualin Garden, feasting ministers at Duting's winding water, ordering kings and dukes and below to compose seven-character poems.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager with Mingdi visited Hualin Garden, feasting ministers at Duting's winding water, ordering kings and dukes and below to compose seven-character poems.

sentences.zh: 太后詩曰：「化光造物含氣貞。

translations.literal: The empress dowager's poem said: "Transforming light creating things, containing qi and upright."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's poem said, "Transforming light creating things, containing qi and upright."

sentences.zh: 」明帝詩曰：「恭己無為賴慈英。

translations.literal: Mingdi's poem said: "Respectfully oneself without action, relying on kind excellence."
translations.idiomatic: Mingdi's poem said, "Respectfully oneself without action, relying on kind excellence."

sentences.zh: 」王公以下賜帛有差。

translations.literal: Kings and dukes and below received cloth and silk in grades.
translations.idiomatic: Kings and dukes and below received cloth and silk in grades.

sentences.zh: 太后父薨，百僚表請公除，太后不許。

translations.literal: The empress dowager's father died; the hundred officials memorialized requesting public mourning leave; the empress dowager did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's father died; the hundred officials memorialized requesting public mourning leave; the empress dowager did not permit.

sentences.zh: 尋幸永寧寺，觀建刹於九級之基，僧尼士女赴者數萬人。

translations.literal: Soon she visited Yongning Temple, viewing a stupa built on a nine-tier foundation; monks, nuns, gentlemen and ladies who came numbered tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Soon she visited Yongning Temple, viewing a stupa built on a nine-tier foundation; monks, nuns, gentlemen and ladies who came numbered tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 及改葬文昭高后，太后不欲令明帝主事，乃自為喪主。

translations.literal: When re-burying Wenzhao Empress Gao, the empress dowager did not wish Mingdi to preside; she herself was mourning chief.
translations.idiomatic: When re-burying Wenzhao Empress Gao, the empress dowager did not wish Mingdi to preside; she herself was mourning chief.

sentences.zh: 出至終寧陵，親奠遣事，還哭於太極殿，至於訖事，皆自主焉。

translations.literal: Going out to Zhongning Tomb, she personally offered the sending-off; returning to weep at Taiji Hall—until the affair ended, all was self-directed.
translations.idiomatic: Going out to Zhongning Tomb, she personally offered the sending-off; returning to weep at Taiji Hall—until the affair ended, all was self-directed.

sentences.zh: 后幸嵩高山，夫人、九嬪、公主以下從者數百人，升於頂中。

translations.literal: The empress dowager visited Song Mountain; ladies, nine pin, princesses and below who followed numbered several hundred; they ascended the summit.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager visited Song Mountain; ladies, nine pin, princesses and below who followed numbered several hundred; they ascended the summit.

sentences.zh: 廢諸淫祀，而胡天神不在其例。

translations.literal: Profligate shrines were abolished; the Hu Heaven god was not in that category.
translations.idiomatic: Profligate shrines were abolished; the Hu Heaven god was not in that category.

sentences.zh: 尋幸闕口溫水，登雞頭山，自射象牙簪，一發中之，敕示文武。

translations.literal: Soon she visited Quekou hot springs, ascended Cock-head Mountain, herself shot an ivory hairpin—one shot hit it; edict shown to civil and military.
translations.idiomatic: Soon she visited Quekou hot springs, ascended Cock-head Mountain, herself shot an ivory hairpin—one shot hit it; edict shown to civil and military.

sentences.zh: 時太后逼幸清河王懌，淫亂肆情，為天下所惡。

translations.literal: At the time the empress dowager forced favor on Prince of Qinghe Yi; wanton disorder and passion unrestrained—hated by the realm.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the empress dowager forced favor on Prince of Qinghe Yi; wanton disorder and passion unrestrained—hated by the realm.

sentences.zh: 領軍元叉、長秋卿劉騰等奉明帝于顯陽殿，幽太后于北宮，於禁中殺懌。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Yuan Cha and Chief of Autumn Liu Teng and others presented Mingdi at Xianyang Hall; the empress dowager was confined in the North Palace; Yi was killed in the forbidden inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Yuan Cha and Chief of Autumn Liu Teng and others presented Mingdi at Xianyang Hall; the empress dowager was confined in the North Palace; Yi was killed in the forbidden inner palace.

sentences.zh: 其後太后從子都統僧敬與備身左右張車渠等數十人謀殺叉，復奉太后臨朝。

translations.literal: Later the empress dowager's sister's son Commander-in-Chief Sengjing with bodyguard Zhang Chequ and others several tens plotted to kill Cha and again present the empress dowager to hold court.
translations.idiomatic: Later the empress dowager's sister's son commander-in-chief Sengjing with bodyguard Zhang Chequ and others several tens plotted to kill Cha and again present the empress dowager to hold court.

sentences.zh: 事不克，僧敬坐徙邊，車渠等死，胡氏多免黜。

translations.literal: The affair did not succeed; Sengjing was condemned to frontier exile; Chequ and the rest died; many of the Hu clan were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The affair did not succeed; Sengjing was condemned to frontier exile; Chequ and the rest died; many of the Hu clan were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 後明帝朝太后于西林園，宴文武侍臣，飲至日夕，叉乃起至太后前自陳，外雲太后欲害己及騰。

translations.literal: Later Mingdi attended the empress dowager at Xilin Garden, feasting civil and military attendants; drinking until evening; Cha then rose before the empress dowager and stated himself—outside it was said the empress dowager wished to harm him and Teng.
translations.idiomatic: Later Mingdi attended the empress dowager at Xilin Garden, feasting civil and military attendants; drinking until evening; Cha then rose before the empress dowager and stated himself—outside it was said the empress dowager wished to harm him and Teng.

sentences.zh: 太后答云：「無此語。

translations.literal: The empress dowager answered: "There is no such word."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager answered, "There is no such word."

sentences.zh: 」遂至於極昏。

translations.literal: It reached extreme drunkenness.
translations.idiomatic: It reached extreme drunkenness.

sentences.zh: 太后乃起執明帝手下堂，言：「母子不聚久，今暮共一宿，諸大臣送我入。

translations.literal: The empress dowager then rose, took Mingdi's hand off the hall, saying: "Mother and son cannot long gather—this evening share one night—great ministers send me in."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager then rose, took Mingdi's hand off the hall, saying, "Mother and son cannot long gather—this evening share one night—great ministers send me in."

sentences.zh: 」太后與帝向東北小閣，左衛將軍奚康生謀殺叉不果。

translations.literal: The empress dowager and emperor went to the northeast small pavilion; Left Guard General Xi Kangsheng plotted to kill Cha without success.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager and emperor went to the northeast small pavilion; Left Guard General Xi Kangsheng plotted to kill Cha without success.

sentences.zh: 自劉騰死，叉又寬怠，太后與明帝及高陽王雍為計，解叉領軍。

translations.literal: From Liu Teng's death, Cha again grew lax; the empress dowager with Mingdi and Prince of Gaoyang Yong made a plan and removed Cha from command.
translations.idiomatic: From Liu Teng's death, Cha again grew lax; the empress dowager with Mingdi and Prince of Gaoyang Yong made a plan and removed Cha from command.

sentences.zh: 太后復臨朝，大赦改元。

translations.literal: The empress dowager again held court; great amnesty and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager again held court; great amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 自是朝政疏緩，威恩不立，天下牧守，所在貪婪。

translations.literal: From this court government grew slack; might and favor were not established; prefects and shepherds everywhere were greedy.
translations.idiomatic: From this court government grew slack; might and favor were not established; prefects and shepherds everywhere were greedy.

sentences.zh: 鄭儼汙亂宮掖，勢傾海內；

translations.literal: Zheng Yan defiled the palace; power tilted over the seas;
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yan defiled the palace; power tilted over the seas;

sentences.zh: 李神軌、徐紇並見親侍，一二年中，位總禁要。

translations.literal: Li Shengui and Xu He were both intimately attended; within one or two years posts held all critical keys.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shengui and Xu He were both intimately attended; within one or two years posts held all critical keys.

sentences.zh: 手握王爵，輕重在心，宣淫於朝，為四方之所穢。

translations.literal: Holding royal ranks in hand, weight and light in heart; wantonness in court—filthied by the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Holding royal ranks in hand, weight and light in heart; wantonness in court—filthied by the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 文武解體，所在亂逆，土崩魚爛，由於此矣。

translations.literal: Civil and military dissolved; everywhere rebellion; earth collapsed and fish rotted—from this it came.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military dissolved; everywhere rebellion; earth collapsed and fish rotted—from this it came.

sentences.zh: 僧敬又因聚集親族，遂涕泣諫曰：「陛下母儀海內，豈宜輕脫如此！

translations.literal: Sengjing again at a clan gathering wept and admonished: "Your Majesty mother-model over the seas—how can you lightly cast off thus!"
translations.idiomatic: Sengjing again at a clan gathering wept and admonished, "Your Majesty mother-model over the seas—how can you lightly cast off thus!"

sentences.zh: 」太后大怒，自是不召僧敬。

translations.literal: The empress dowager greatly angered; from then she did not summon Sengjing.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager greatly angered; from then she did not summon Sengjing.

sentences.zh: 內為朋黨，防弊耳目，明帝所親幸者，太后多以事害焉。

translations.literal: Inwardly forming factions, guarding against and blocking ears and eyes—those Mingdi favored, the empress dowager mostly harmed by affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Inwardly forming factions, guarding against and blocking ears and eyes—those Mingdi favored, the empress dowager mostly harmed by affairs.

sentences.zh: 有蜜多道人，能胡語，帝置於左右。

translations.literal: There was the monk Miduo, able in Hu language; the emperor placed him at his side.
translations.idiomatic: There was the monk Miduo, able in Hu language; the emperor placed him at his side.

sentences.zh: 太后慮其傳致消息，三月三日，于城南大巷中殺之，方懸賞募賊。

translations.literal: The empress dowager feared he would transmit news; on the third day of the third month, in the great lane south of the city she killed him—just as a reward for catching thieves was posted.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager feared he would transmit news; on the third day of the third month, in the great lane south of the city she killed him—just as a reward for catching thieves was posted.

sentences.zh: 又於禁中殺領左右、鴻臚少卿穀會、紹達，並帝所親也。

translations.literal: Also in the forbidden palace she killed Director of Attendants and Chamberlain for Dependencies Gu Hui and Shao Da—also those the emperor favored.
translations.idiomatic: Also in the forbidden palace she killed Director of Attendants and Chamberlain for Dependencies Gu Hui and Shao Da—also those the emperor favored.

sentences.zh: 母子之間，嫌隙屢起。

translations.literal: Between mother and son, rifts arose repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Between mother and son, rifts arose repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 鄭儼慮禍，乃與太后計，因潘嬪生女，妄言皇子，便大赦，為武泰元年，復陰行鴆毒。

translations.literal: Zheng Yan feared disaster; then with the empress dowager schemed—because Consort Pan bore a girl, falsely saying a prince, then great amnesty, Wutai first year, again secretly administered poison.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yan feared disaster; then with the empress dowager schemed—because Consort Pan bore a girl, falsely saying a prince, then great amnesty, Wutai first year, again secretly administered poison.

sentences.zh: 其年二月，明帝暴崩，乃奉潘嬪女，言太子即位。

translations.literal: That year in the second month Mingdi died suddenly; then they presented Consort Pan's girl, saying the crown prince took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the second month Mingdi died suddenly; then they presented Consort Pan's girl, saying the crown prince took the throne.

sentences.zh: 經數日，見人心已安，始言潘嬪本實生女，今宜更擇嗣君，遂立臨洮王子釗為主，年始二、三歲，天下愕然。

translations.literal: After several days, seeing men's hearts were settled, they then said Consort Pan had truly borne a girl—now one should choose another heir; then they established Prince of Linzi Zhaozhu as lord, age only two or three— the realm was startled.
translations.idiomatic: After several days, seeing men's hearts were settled, they then said Consort Pan had truly borne a girl—now one should choose another heir; then they established Prince of Linzi Zhaozhu as lord, age only two or three—the realm was startled.

sentences.zh: 及爾硃榮稱兵度河，太后盡召明帝六宮，皆令入道，太后亦自落發。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong raised troops crossing the river, the empress dowager summoned all Mingdi's six palaces to enter the Way; the empress dowager also shaved her head.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong raised troops crossing the river, the empress dowager summoned all Mingdi's six palaces to enter the Way; the empress dowager also shaved her head.

sentences.zh: 榮遣騎拘送太后及幼主于河陰。

translations.literal: Rong sent riders to seize and send the empress dowager and the young lord to Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: Rong sent riders to seize and send the empress dowager and the young lord to Heyin.

sentences.zh: 太后對榮多所陳說，榮拂衣而起。

translations.literal: The empress dowager to Rong made many explanations; Rong brushed his robe and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager to Rong made many explanations; Rong brushed his robe and rose.

sentences.zh: 太后及幼主並沈於河。

translations.literal: The empress dowager and young lord were both sunk in the river.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager and young lord were both sunk in the river.

sentences.zh: 太后妹馮翊君收瘞於雙靈寺。

translations.literal: The empress dowager's younger sister Lady of Fengyi collected burial at Shuangling Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's younger sister Lady of Fengyi collected burial at Shuangling Temple.

sentences.zh: 武帝時，始葬以后禮，而追加諡曰靈。

translations.literal: Under Wudi, she was first buried with empress ritual; posthumous title Ling was added.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wudi, she was first buried with empress ritual; posthumous title Ling was added.

sentences.zh: 孝明皇后胡氏，靈太后從兄冀州刺史盛之女。

translations.literal: Xiaoming Empress Hu was daughter of the empress dowager's cousin, Inspector of Jizhou Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoming Empress Hu was daughter of the empress dowager's cousin, inspector of Jizhou Sheng.

sentences.zh: 靈太后欲榮重門族，故立為皇后。

translations.literal: The empress dowager wished to honor the clan's weight; therefore she was established empress.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager wished to honor the clan's weight; therefore she was established empress.

sentences.zh: 明帝頗有酒德，專嬖充華潘氏，后及嬪御並無過寵。

translations.literal: Mingdi had much wine virtue; he exclusively favored chonghua Pan; the empress and pin and attendants all had no excess favor.
translations.idiomatic: Mingdi had much wine virtue; he exclusively favored chonghua Pan; the empress and pin and attendants all had no excess favor.

sentences.zh: 太后為帝選納，抑屈人流。

translations.literal: The empress dowager chose and accepted matches for the emperor, suppressing and bending the flow of men.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager chose and accepted matches for the emperor, suppressing and bending the flow of men.

sentences.zh: 時博陵崔孝芬、范陽盧道約、隴西李瓚等女，俱為世婦。

translations.literal: At the time Boling Cui Xiaofen, Fanyang Lu Daoyue, Longxi Li Zan and other daughters were all world wives.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Boling Cui Xiaofen, Fanyang Lu Daoyue, Longxi Li Zan and other daughters were all world wives.

sentences.zh: 諸人訴訟，咸見忿責。

translations.literal: All who sued were angrily reproached.
translations.idiomatic: All who sued were angrily reproached.

sentences.zh: 武泰初，后既入道，遂居於瑤光寺。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wutai the empress had entered the Way; then she dwelt at Yaoguang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wutai the empress had entered the Way; then she dwelt at Yaoguang Temple.

sentences.zh: 孝武皇后高氏，齊神武長女也。

translations.literal: Xiaowu Empress Gao was Qi Shenwu's eldest daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaowu Empress Gao was Qi Shenwu's eldest daughter.

sentences.zh: 帝見立，乃納為后。

translations.literal: When the emperor was established, she was taken as empress.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was established, she was taken as empress.

sentences.zh: 及帝西幸關中，降為彭城王韶妃。

translations.literal: When the emperor went west to Guanzhong, she was demoted to consort of Prince of Pengcheng Shao.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went west to Guanzhong, she was demoted to consort of Prince of Pengcheng Shao.

sentences.zh: 文帝文皇后乙弗氏，河南洛陽人也。

translations.literal: Wendi Wen Empress Yifu was a man of Luoyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wendi Wen Empress Yifu was a man of Luoyang in Henan.

sentences.zh: 其先世為吐谷渾渠帥，居青海，號青海王。

translations.literal: Her ancestors for generations were Tuyuhun chieftains, dwelling at Qinghai, titled King of Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Her ancestors for generations were Tuyuhun chieftains, dwelling at Qinghai, titled King of Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 涼州平，后之高祖莫瑰擁部落入附，拜定州刺史，封西平公。

translations.literal: When Liangzhou was pacified, the empress's great-grandfather Mogui led his tribe to submit; appointed Inspector of Dingzhou, enfeoffed Duke of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: When Liangzhou was pacified, the empress's great-grandfather Mogui led his tribe to submit; appointed inspector of Dingzhou, enfeoffed Duke of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 自莫瑰後，三世尚公主，女乃多為王妃，甚見貴重。

translations.literal: From Mogui onward, three generations married princesses; daughters mostly became kings' consorts—greatly honored.
translations.idiomatic: From Mogui onward, three generations married princesses; daughters mostly became kings' consorts—greatly honored.

sentences.zh: 父瑗，儀同三司、兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Father Yuan, Acting Three Excellencies, Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Father Yuan, acting three excellencies, inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 母淮陽長公主，孝文之第四女也。

translations.literal: Mother Princess of Huaiyang, Xiaowen's fourth daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Mother Princess of Huaiyang, Xiaowen's fourth daughter.

sentences.zh: 后美容儀，少言笑，年數歲，父母異之，指示諸親曰：「生女何妨也。

translations.literal: The empress had beautiful bearing; in youth little speech or laughter; her parents thought her unusual and showed relatives: "Bearing a daughter—what harm?
translations.idiomatic: The empress had beautiful bearing; in youth little speech or laughter; her parents thought her unusual and showed relatives, "Bearing a daughter—what harm?

sentences.zh: 若此者，實勝男。

translations.literal: If like this one, she truly surpasses a son."
translations.idiomatic: If like this one, she truly surpasses a son."

sentences.zh: 」年十六，文帝納為妃。

translations.literal: At sixteen Wendi took her as consort.
translations.idiomatic: At sixteen Wendi took her as consort.

sentences.zh: 及帝即位，以大統元年冊為皇后。

translations.literal: When the emperor took the throne, in the first year of Datong she was enfeoffed empress.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor took the throne, in the first year of Datong she was enfeoffed empress.

sentences.zh: 后性好節儉，蔬食故衣，珠玉羅綺絕於服玩。

translations.literal: The empress by nature loved frugality—vegetarian food and old clothes; pearls, jade, silk, and brocade were absent from dress and play.
translations.idiomatic: The empress by nature loved frugality—vegetarian food and old clothes; pearls, jade, silk, and brocade were absent from dress and play.

sentences.zh: 又仁恕不為嫉妒之心，帝益重之。

translations.literal: Also humane and forgiving without a jealous heart—the emperor further valued her.
translations.idiomatic: Also humane and forgiving without a jealous heart—the emperor further valued her.

sentences.zh: 生男女十二人，多早夭，唯太子及武都王戊存焉。

translations.literal: She bore sons and daughters twelve; most died young—only the crown prince and Prince of Wudu Wu survived.
translations.idiomatic: She bore sons and daughters twelve; most died young—only the crown prince and Prince of Wudu Wu survived.

sentences.zh: 時新都關中，務欲東討，蠕蠕寇邊，未遑北伐，故帝結婚以撫之。

translations.literal: At the time the new capital was in Guanzhong; eager to campaign east, Rouran raided the border—northern campaign was not yet possible; therefore the emperor made marriage to soothe them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the new capital was in Guanzhong; eager to campaign east, Rouran raided the border—northern campaign was not yet possible; therefore the emperor made marriage to soothe them.

sentences.zh: 於是更納悼后，命后遜居別宮，出家為尼。

translations.literal: Then he further took in the Dao empress; he ordered the empress to yield dwelling in a separate palace and leave home as a nun.
translations.idiomatic: Then he further took in the Dao empress; he ordered the empress to yield dwelling in a separate palace and leave home as a nun.

sentences.zh: 悼后猶懷猜忌，復徙后居秦州，依子秦州刺史武都王。

translations.literal: The Dao empress still harbored suspicion; again moved the empress to dwell in Qinzhou, relying on her son, Inspector of Qinzhou Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: The Dao empress still harbored suspicion; again moved the empress to dwell in Qinzhou, relying on her son, inspector of Qinzhou Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 帝雖限大計，恩好不忘，後密令養髮，有追還之意。

translations.literal: Though the emperor was bound by the great plan, fondness was not forgotten; afterward he secretly ordered her hair nurtured—there was intent to recall.
translations.idiomatic: Though the emperor was bound by the great plan, fondness was not forgotten; afterward he secretly ordered her hair nurtured—there was intent to recall.

sentences.zh: 然事秘禁，外無知者。

translations.literal: Yet the affair was secret and forbidden; outwardly none knew.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the affair was secret and forbidden; outwardly none knew.

sentences.zh: 六年春，蠕蠕舉國度河，前驅已過夏，頗有言虜為悼后之故興比役。

translations.literal: In the sixth year spring, Rouran led the state across the river; the vanguard had already passed Xia; many said the barbarians rose this campaign because of the Dao empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year spring, Rouran led the state across the river; the vanguard had already passed Xia; many said the barbarians rose this campaign because of the Dao empress.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「豈有百萬之眾為一女子舉也？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "How could a million host be raised for one woman?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "How could a million host be raised for one woman?

sentences.zh: 雖然，致此物論，朕亦何顏以見將帥邪！

translations.literal: Even so, to produce this talk—what face have I to see the generals!"
translations.idiomatic: Even so, to produce this talk—what face have I to see the generals!"

sentences.zh: 」乃遣中常侍曹寵齎手敕令后自盡。

translations.literal: Then he sent Palace Attendant Cao Chong with hand edict ordering the empress to end herself.
translations.idiomatic: Then he sent Palace Attendant Cao Chong with hand edict ordering the empress to end herself.

sentences.zh: 后奉敕，揮淚謂寵曰：「願至尊享千萬歲，天下康寧，死無恨也。

translations.literal: The empress received the edict, brushed tears and told Chong: "May the Supreme Ultimate enjoy ten thousand years, the realm peaceful and secure—I die without regret."
translations.idiomatic: The empress received the edict, brushed tears and told Chong, "May the Supreme Ultimate enjoy ten thousand years, the realm peaceful and secure—I die without regret."

sentences.zh: 」因命武都王前，與之決。

translations.literal: She then ordered Prince of Wudu forward to part with him.
translations.idiomatic: She then ordered Prince of Wudu forward to part with him.

sentences.zh: 遺語皇太子，辭皆悽愴，因慟哭久之。

translations.literal: She left words for the crown prince—words all mournful; she wept bitterly long.
translations.idiomatic: She left words for the crown prince—words all mournful; she wept bitterly long.

sentences.zh: 侍御咸垂涕失聲，莫能仰視。

translations.literal: Attendants all shed tears and lost voice; none could look up.
translations.idiomatic: Attendees all shed tears and lost voice; none could look up.

sentences.zh: 召僧設供，令侍婢數十人出家，手中落發。

translations.literal: She summoned monks to set offerings; ordered several tens of maidservants to leave home; hair fell from their hands.
translations.idiomatic: She summoned monks to set offerings; ordered several tens of maidservants to leave home; hair fell from their hands.

sentences.zh: 事畢，乃入室，引被自覆而崩，年三十一。

translations.literal: When the affair was done, she entered the chamber, pulled the coverlet over herself and died, age thirty-one.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was done, she entered the chamber, pulled the coverlet over herself and died, age thirty-one.

sentences.zh: 鑿麥積崖為龕而葬，神柩將入，有二叢雲先入龕中，頃之一滅一出，后號寂陵。

translations.literal: Maijiji Cliff was carved for a niche and burial; as the spirit coffin entered, two cloud clusters first entered the niche—soon one vanished and one emerged; her mound title was Jiling.
translations.idiomatic: Maijiji Cliff was carved for a niche and burial; as the spirit coffin entered, two cloud clusters first entered the niche—soon one vanished and one emerged; her mound title was Jiling.

sentences.zh: 及文帝山陵畢，手書雲，萬歲後欲令兵配饗。

translations.literal: When Wendi's mountain tomb was finished, a hand writ said: after ten thousand years wish military paired sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When Wendi's mountain tomb was finished, a hand writ said: after ten thousand years wish military paired sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 公卿乃議追諡曰文皇后，祔于太廟。

translations.literal: Dukes and ministers then debated posthumous title Wen Empress, attached at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes and ministers then debated posthumous title Wen Empress, attached at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 廢帝時，合葬於永陵。

translations.literal: Under the Deposed Emperor, joint burial at Yong Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Deposed Emperor, joint burial at Yong Tomb.

sentences.zh: 文帝悼皇后郁久閭氏，蠕蠕主阿那瑰之長女也。

translations.literal: Wendi Dao Empress Yujiulü was eldest daughter of Rouran lord Anagui.
translations.idiomatic: Wendi Dao Empress Yujiulü was eldest daughter of Rouran lord Anagui.

sentences.zh: 容貌端嚴，夙有成智。

translations.literal: Bearing and appearance proper and stern; from youth had mature wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing and appearance proper and stern; from youth had mature wisdom.

sentences.zh: 大統初，蠕蠕屢犯北邊，文帝乃與約，通好結婚，扶風王孚受使奉迎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Datong, Rouran repeatedly encroached the northern border; Wendi then made treaty, friendly marriage; Prince of Fufeng Fu received commission to welcome.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Datong, Rouran repeatedly encroached the northern border; Wendi then made treaty, friendly marriage; Prince of Fufeng Fu received commission to welcome.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕俗以東為貴，后之來，營幕戶席，一皆東向。

translations.literal: By Rouran custom the east was honored; when the empress came, camp tents and mats all faced east.
translations.idiomatic: By Rouran custom the east was honored; when the empress came, camp tents and mats all faced east.

sentences.zh: 車七百乘，馬萬匹，駝千頭。

translations.literal: Seven hundred carts, ten thousand horses, a thousand camels.
translations.idiomatic: Seven hundred carts, ten thousand horses, a thousand camels.

sentences.zh: 到黑鹽池，魏朝鹵簿文物始至。

translations.literal: At Black Salt Pool, Wei court insignia and regalia first arrived.
translations.idiomatic: At Black Salt Pool, Wei court insignia and regalia first arrived.

sentences.zh: 孚奏請正南面，后曰：「我未見魏主，故蠕蠕女也。

translations.literal: Fu memorialized requesting to face south; the empress said: "I have not seen the Wei lord—thus I am still a Rouran woman.
translations.idiomatic: Fu memorialized requesting to face south; the empress said, "I have not seen the Wei lord—thus I am still a Rouran woman.

sentences.zh: 魏仗向南，我自東面。

translations.literal: Wei arms face south—I myself face east."
translations.idiomatic: Wei arms face south—I myself face east."

sentences.zh: 」孚無以辭。

translations.literal: Fu had no words.
translations.idiomatic: Fu had no words.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，至京師，立為皇后，時年十四。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year she reached the capital; established empress, age fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year she reached the capital; established empress, age fourteen.

sentences.zh: 六年，后懷孕將產，居於瑤華殿，聞上有狗吠聲，心甚惡之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the empress was pregnant and about to bear; she dwelt at Yaohua Hall; hearing dogs bark above, her heart greatly hated it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the empress was pregnant and about to bear; she dwelt at Yaohua Hall; hearing dogs bark above, her heart greatly hated it.

sentences.zh: 又見婦人盛飾來至后所，后謂左右：「此為何人？

translations.literal: Also she saw a woman in full adornment come to the empress's place; the empress asked attendants: "Who is this person?"
translations.idiomatic: Also she saw a woman in full adornment come to the empress's place; the empress asked attendants, "Who is this person?"

sentences.zh: 」醫巫傍侍，悉無見者，時以為文后之靈。

translations.literal: Physicians and shamans at the side—all none saw; at the time it was thought Wen Empress's spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Physicians and shamans at the side—all none saw; at the time it was thought Wen Empress's spirit.

sentences.zh: 產訖而崩，年十六，葬于少陵原。

translations.literal: When bearing was finished she died, age sixteen; buried at Shaoling Plain.
translations.idiomatic: When bearing was finished she died, age sixteen; buried at Shaoling Plain.

sentences.zh: 十七年，合葬永陵。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, joint burial at Yong Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, joint burial at Yong Tomb.

sentences.zh: 當會橫橋北，后梓宮先至鹿苑，帝巉輬後來，將就次所，軌折不進。

translations.literal: When meeting at Heng Bridge north, the empress's inner coffin first reached Deer Park; the emperor's hearse came after; about to reach the resting place—the shaft broke and would not advance.
translations.idiomatic: When meeting at Heng Bridge north, the empress's inner coffin first reached Deer Park; the emperor's hearse came after; about to reach the resting place—the shaft broke and would not advance.

sentences.zh: 恭帝皇后若干氏，司空長樂正公惠之女也。

translations.literal: Gongdi Empress Ruogan was daughter of Minister of Works Duke of Changle Zheng Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Gongdi Empress Ruogan was daughter of Minister of Works Duke of Changle Zheng Hui.

sentences.zh: 有容色，恭帝納之為妃。

translations.literal: She had bearing and color; Gongdi took her as consort.
translations.idiomatic: She had bearing and color; Gongdi took her as consort.

sentences.zh: 及即位，立為皇后。

translations.literal: When he took the throne, she was established empress.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne, she was established empress.

sentences.zh: 後出家為尼，在佛寺薨，竟無諡。

translations.literal: Later she left home as a nun; she died in a Buddhist temple—ultimately no posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Later she left home as a nun; she died in a Buddhist temple—ultimately no posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 孝靜皇后高氏，齊神武之第二女也。

translations.literal: Xiaojing Empress Gao was Qi Shenwu's second daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojing Empress Gao was Qi Shenwu's second daughter.

sentences.zh: 天平四年，詔娉以為皇后，神武前後固辭，帝不許。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianping an edict betrothed her as empress; Shenwu before and after firmly declined—the emperor did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tianping an edict betrothed her as empress; Shenwu before and after firmly declined—the emperor did not permit.

sentences.zh: 興和初，詔司徒孫騰、司空襄城王昶等奉詔致禮，以后駕迎于晉陽之丞相第。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xinghe, edict ordered Minister of State Sun Teng, Minister of Works Prince of Xiangcheng Chang and others to bear edict and perform ritual; the empress was welcomed by carriage from the chancellor's residence at Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xinghe, edict ordered Minister of State Sun Teng, Minister of Works Prince of Xiangcheng Chang and others to bear edict and perform ritual; the empress was welcomed by carriage from the chancellor's residence at Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 五月，立為皇后，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month she was established empress; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month she was established empress; great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 齊受禪，降為中山王妃。

translations.literal: When Qi received the mandate, she was demoted to consort of Prince of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi received the mandate, she was demoted to consort of Prince of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 后降于尚書左僕射楊遵彥。

translations.literal: The empress married Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yang Zunyan.
translations.idiomatic: The empress married Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yang Zunyan.
